credits.title: NMB48 10th Anniversary LIVE ～心を一つに、One for all, All for one～
AKB48 Tandoku Concert ~Jabajatte Nani?~
credits.overview: "AKB48 Tandoku Concert ~Jabajatte Nani?~" (AKB48単独コンサート〜ジャーバージャって何？〜) is AKB48's spring concert. The concert was held at Saitama Super Arena on April 1, 2018. It was the first concert with the new Teams since the AKB48 12th Anniversary Shuffle.
